name: Retro
description: Warm 1970s color, a rounded frame, and a hard shadow.
bestFor: Menus, music, and products that should feel analog and sun-faded.
promptFragment: Visual style: Retro. Use cream, burnt orange, and brown, a warm serif, 14px corners, and a hard offset shadow in the same brown. Borders are thick and solid. Avoid neon, pure gray, a thin modern sans, and glass. Keep text readable: meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1) against the surface the text actually sits on. https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html
